title: Reference
description: Look up command behavior, adapter responsibilities, and the trust boundaries behind a setup.

sections.title: Commands and implementations
paragraphs: Use the command reference with the help output from your installed CLI. Check adapter coverage before expecting a module selection to work through another provisioning system.

sections.title: Trust and safety
paragraphs: Understand what previews inspect, what execution can change, and how to handle secrets and diagnostic reports. Consult the practical review guide when deciding whether to apply a plan.
